text:
Maria (Sales): Heads-up — TitanHealth POC moving to procurement. They want invoices split across: TitanHealth Inc (US), TitanHealth EU Ltd (IE), and TitanHealth Labs (UK). Procurement insists each entity has its own signer and PO number. Also asking for an HSM/KMS addendum in the DPA. Can we support multi-entity billing + per-entity signer routing?

Ben (Legal): We can support multi-entity billing but need to lock down master billing entity for tax/SAF reconciliation. Per-entity signers ok if each signs an order form that references the MSA. Need to see the DPA redline for the HSM clause — typical ask is unacceptable as-is.

Kai (Solutions Eng): From a POC infra perspective we can tag requests by tenant and route billing metadata. Signer routing is not technical blocking — we'll add metadata fields so orderform -> invoice mapping matches entity. Suggest this structure in the OF: 
```
billing_entity: titanhealth-eu-ltd
po_number: TH-PROC-1234
signer_name: Jane Doe
signer_email: jane@titanhealth.eu
```

Olivia (Finance): Need to confirm: will legal require separate invoices per entity? If yes, invoices must be distinct with separate tax IDs. Also net terms: procurement is asking net30, but our default at this stage is net45 for POCs. We can make exception if sales confirms credit review.

Maria (Sales): They specifically want net30. Can finance do net30 for a POC if credit pass? I can get the procurement contact to share tax IDs today.

Jeremy (Security): Quick note on the HSM/KMS ask — our standard is to support customer-managed keys in Private deployments only. Hosted customers get KMS + SOC2 controls but not dedicated HSMs. If they require HSM-backed key custody for the POC, that's an escalation to Product and enterprise/private offering.

Ben (Legal): Upload the customer's redline here when you have it. Two legal items to flag: 1) HSM language that shifts custody/availability risk to us — we should push back. 2) They added a 30-day deletion SLA for backups in the DPA; that's incompatible with our backup retention for infra. Propose: counter with 90-day retention and documented purge procedure.

Maria (Sales): Copying procurement contact: @procurement_titan (cc). Procurement said they "prefer HSM or attestable KMS" and want 3rd-party audit language.

Olivia (Finance): If we do per-entity invoices, we need separate billing accounts created in Stripe/AR. That's doable but ops needs PO/Entity mapping before first invoice. Maria — can you confirm POC start date?

Maria (Sales): POC start planned 2026-04-12 pending OF countersign. I'll get tax IDs and the redlined DPA by EOD.

Kai (Solutions Eng): For routing, I'll prep a small doc with the expected orderform payload and sample invoice schema. I'll include a fallback: if signer not mapped, route to parent-account finance email.

Ben (Legal): Good. After we see redline: we can propose: (a) HSM language limited to Private deployments, (b) KMS attestation + pen-test report for Hosted, (c) delete/retention compromise = 90 days + documented purge.

Jeremy (Security): Also request from procurement: "Can you provide key attestation or encryption-in-transit diagrams?" I can attach our KMS whitepaper and SOC2 section.

Maria (Sales): Thanks — sounds like plan. Procurement — please send the DPA redline + entity tax IDs. Also confirm whether they need separate legal countersigners or delegated PO signers (finance ops).

procurement_titan: Thanks @Maria — we'll go get the redlines and tax IDs. Quick Q: for entity-specific signers, do you accept delegated finance signers (e.g., AP-team) or only legal execs?

Ben (Legal): Delegated finance signers are acceptable for order forms if the signatory has authority. We usually ask for a simple signatory attestation: name, role, and confirmation they can bind the entity. We'll draft a one-line attestation clause.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: none — informational. :robot_face:

Olivia (Finance): FYI — if they choose net30 we'll queue a credit check. If credit clear, finance can approve net30 for POC only. If credit fails, default to prepay for the first month.

Maria (Sales): I'll follow up with procurement and bring the redline + tax IDs back here. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
